`demo_export/` is the `demo_tracks` Rekordbox USB export from the
[rekordcrate](https://github.com/Holzhaus/rekordcrate) test data (MPL-2.0).
It has the analysis files but no audio.

`large_export.pdb` is rekordcrate's `data/pdb/num_rows/export.pdb` (MPL-2.0): a
real-world export with ~3,900 tracks and a nested playlist tree, used to check
our reader against rekordcrate's.
